title: Ettinger

page_data.en:
Form 2    34
C. I. D.
X. O. REC
Shanghai Municipal Police. No. 626
Date 9/10/16
Central Police Station.
October 4th, 1916.
REPORT ON The Result of a Watch kept on the Movements of Ettinger
from the 25th September to the 3rd October.
Made by D.S.I. Brewster. Forwarded by
Sir,
Ettinger still lives at 33 Nanzing Road and appears to have
no permanent employment. On the 25th inst. we were unable to
locate him. On the 26th inst. from 6 to 7 p.m. strolled around
and then visited the German Club where he stayed for the evening.
On the 27th inst. at 7 p.m. he visited a Japanese Bar at 32
Chapoo Road leaving at 8 p.m. and to Neumann's Restaurant where
he stayed all the evening. About 7 p.m. 28th inst. he visited
German Club where he stayed all the evening. About 4 p.m. 29th
inst. to German Club and met one Rosenberger or Rosenberg who
accompanied him to a coffee shop 38 Chapoo Road. Both left at
7 p.m. and parted, Ettinger going home. At 11 a.m. on the
30th inst. visited Berthel. At 8 p.m. visited the house of
Max Engel 105 Avenue Road where he stayed a few minutes and
returned home. On the 1st inst. he did not leave home all day.
At 10.30 a.m. on the 2nd inst. he visited 30 Nanzing Road and
then to German Club. At 12 noon to 17a Nanking Road and then
to 38 Chapoo Road which he left at 4 p.m. and to Public Gardens
where he wandered around for a long time alone.
At 9 a.m. 3rd inst. to German Consulate and from there to
Berthel's place which he left at 11 a.m. for Astor House which
he left after tiffin. He then walked aimlessly round town
and finally visited the Austrian Consulate where he received a
letter and returned to German Club, where he stayed until 7
p.m. when he visited Berthel's place staying about half an hour.
Your obedient servant,
WB newman.
Detective Sub-Inspector.
Chief Detective Inspector.

表格 2    34
刑事调查处
X. O. REC
上海公共租界工部局警务处。第 626 号
日期 1916年10月9日
中央巡捕房。
1916年10月4日。
关于9月25日至10月3日期间对艾廷格（Ettinger）行踪进行监视的结果报告。
由副探长布鲁斯特（Brewster）撰写。呈报
先生，
艾廷格仍居住于南京路33号，似乎没有固定职业。本月25日，我们未能找到他的踪迹。本月26日下午6时至7时，他四处闲逛，随后前往德国总会，并在那里度过了当晚。本月27日下午7时，他前往乍浦路32号的一家日本酒吧，于下午8时离开，随后前往诺伊曼餐厅（Neumann's Restaurant），并在那里度过了整晚。本月28日下午7时许，他前往德国总会，并在那里度过了整晚。本月29日下午4时许，他前往德国总会，遇见了一位名为罗森伯格（Rosenberger 或 Rosenberg）的人，此人陪同他前往乍浦路38号的一家咖啡店。两人于下午7时离开并分手，艾廷格回家。本月30日上午11时，他拜访了伯特尔（Berthel）。晚上8时，他前往爱文义路105号马克斯·恩格尔（Max Engel）的住所，停留了几分钟后返回家中。本月1日，他整天未离家。本月2日上午10时30分，他前往南京路30号，随后前往德国总会。中午12时前往南京路17a号，随后前往乍浦路38号，于下午4时离开，接着前往公家花园（Public Gardens），独自在那里徘徊了很长时间。
本月3日上午9时，他前往德国领事馆，随后从那里前往伯特尔的住处，于上午11时离开前往礼查饭店（Astor House），午饭后离开。随后他在市内漫无目的地闲逛，最后前往奥地利领事馆，在那里收到一封信，然后返回德国总会，一直待到下午7时，随后前往伯特尔的住处，停留了约半小时。
您忠实的仆人，
W.B. 纽曼（newman）。
副探长。
首席探长。

Nielsen, the German Chemist, is

H. Givens
